column1: # bug-report Figma node-id -> catalog frame that covers it
# reason: child     = referenced node is a descendant of the catalog frame
#         page      = report linked a whole Figma page, not a frame
#         gone      = node-id no longer resolves in the Figma file
#         copy-file = report linked a DUPLICATE Figma file; node-ids are
#                     preserved by a Figma file copy, so the same id in the
#                     primary Skai-Web-App file is the covering frame
# a refNode may carry a "<fileKey>:" prefix when it is not the primary file
# refNode

# 2026-07-28: 8 wallet multi-menu frames deleted upstream after they were cataloged.
# Found by the page-coverage report: Wallet carried 369 rows against 361 live nodes, and
# a NEGATIVE delta can only mean rows pointing at nodes that are not on the page. All 8
# were confirmed non-resolving via getNodeByIdAsync. They keep status=done because they
# WERE built; recording them gone stops the delta reading as an unexplained anomaly.
# 2026-08-05: 3 Trade frames re-created upstream, so the old node-ids no longer resolve.
# Found by the live re-harvest of the ✅ Trade page: 6 top-level children were missing from
# the catalog while 3 catalogued rows were absent from the page. Three of the six carry the
# SAME frame names as the three missing rows (Frame 267 / 1356 / 1357), i.e. David deleted
# and re-drew them and Figma minted new ids. All 3 confirmed non-resolving via
# getNodeByIdAsync. Replacements are catalogued as 10706-128843 / 10706-128950 /
